title: Cryptographic Utilities Repair
prompt: Fix `crypto_utils.py` so its documented contracts hold. The module provides base64url codec, constant-time comparison, HKDF (RFC 5869), PBKDF2-like password hashing, and JWT-like token handling. Read the docstrings for exact requirements; the current implementation violates several invariants including padding handling, HKDF counter, PBKDF2 iteration count, JSON canonicalization, and signature verification. Keep the public API unchanged and do not add dependencies.
